'''Benedict du Boulay''' is a British computer scientist and one of the pioneers in the area of application of [[Artificial Intelligence]] to education. He is currently Emeritus Professor of Artificial Intelligence in the School of Engineering and Informatics at the [[University of Sussex]] and visiting professor at [[University College London]].

== Biography ==
du Boulay gained a BSc in physics from [[Imperial College London]] (1966) and a PGCE from the [[University of Zambia]] (1968). He completed his PhD in 1978 on [[Logo (programming language)|Logo]] in the Department of Artificial Intelligence at the [[University of Edinburgh]]. He is currently Emeritus Professor of Artificial Intelligence at the [[University of Sussex]].<ref name="CV">{{cite web |title=Curriculum Vitae: John Benedict du Boulay |url=http://users.sussex.ac.uk/~bend/cv/homepagenode2.html |website=users.sussex.ac.uk |access-date=6 July 2023 |date=8 July 2015}}</ref>

His responsibilities in Sussex included Dean of Cognitive and Computing Sciences (1994–1998) as well as Dean of science and Technology (2002–2009).<ref name="sussex">{{cite web|url=https://www.sussex.ac.uk/profiles/762|website=sussex.ac.uk|title=Ben du Boulay : University of Sussex|access-date=2023-07-05}}</ref> His community service to the field of AI in Education included being a President (2015–2017) of the [[International Society for Artificial Intelligence in Education]]<ref name="iaied">{{cite web|url=https://iaied.org/about|website=iaied.org|title=International Artificial Intelligence in Education Society |access-date=2023-07-05}}</ref> and an Associate Editor of its [[International Journal of Artificial Intelligence in Education]].<ref name="springer">{{cite web|url=https://www.springer.com/journal/40593|title=International Journal of Artificial Intelligence in Education {{pipe}} Home|website=springer.com|access-date=2023-07-05}}</ref>

==Research==
du Bolulay edited/wrote 12 books and wrote over 190 papers.<ref name="scholar">{{cite web|url=https://scholar.google.co.uk/citations?user=QBJBsuMAAAAJ&hl=en|publisher=Google Scholar|title=List of du Boulay publications in Google Scholar |access-date=2023-11-11}}</ref> His most recent book is Handbook of AI in Education.

== Publications ==
* Benedict du Boulay and Riichiro Mizoguchi (eds.) Proceedings of AI-ED'97, 8th World Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education, Kobe, Japan, 18–22 August 1997, IOS, 1997
* Christopher Thornton and Benedict Du Boulay (eds.) Artificial Intelligence: Strategies, Applications, and Models Through Search. Amacom Books, 1999.
* Carmel Kent and Ben Du Boulay, AI for Learning. CRC Press, 2022 
* Benedict du Boulay, Antonia Mitrovic and Kalina Yacef (eds.): Handbook of Artificial Intelligence in Education. Edward Elgar, 2023.
